original_test_intent: Verify every applicable PCIe slot/NIC path sustains 12-hour network stress at 0C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails with per-path throughput above the approved 80% baseline and no link/platform errors.
original_method: Map each physical slot to NIC serial/BDF/netdev/root port/lane and peer; control dry chamber/dew point, cold-soak and ramp to measured -5% rails; verify links, run approved SST profile for 12 hours with complete simultaneous/sequential slot coverage, record per-path throughput/errors and AER/link/rail/temperature telemetry; abort on limits, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator installs/routes NICs, controls dry chamber/negative rails, supervises the run and warms/restores hardware.
required_inputs: Per-slot link/AER/error/thermal abort and warm-up plan
safety_requirements: Measure rails independently and prevent undervoltage undershoot
Abort on link/AER, moisture, electrical or thermal fault
Warm above dew point before opening chamber or moving cards
agent_execution_scope: May validate mappings and analyze per-slot throughput/health artifacts
Must not control chamber/rails, move cards/cables or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve slot matrix, traffic baseline and cold/low-rail profile
Review every slot and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; generic network stress cannot prove every slot without a physical identity matrix.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run approved SST against each mapped NIC path only after dry cold soak and measured low-rail stability.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Every PCIe slot, network stress, 12 hours, 0C, -5% 5V/3.3V and >80% throughput are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate per-slot traffic with root-port AER/link and continuous dew-point/rail data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds slot identity, bandwidth calculation, condensation/undervoltage controls, per-path evidence and warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One NIC path or aggregate throughput cannot prove every physical slot.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold and low rails can jointly degrade link training or cause retries without terminating network traffic.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines applicable slots, card-move/full-population method, per-path versus aggregate threshold and cold stabilization.
expected_evidence: Safe warm-up, restored topology and nominal health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria align on every-slot network stress at cold/low-rail margin.

review_improvement: Makes every-slot cold/low-rail coverage attributable and adds the condensation and undervoltage controls needed for credible evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A network test represents PCIe slot coverage only when each NIC/root-port identity and negotiated link are captured. Low rails may produce retraining or corrected AER while traffic continues, so throughput must be interpreted with link health and measured rail evidence.
